changes: Rebuilt the public LEXA landing experience around the supplied brand identity

Removed workspace ID entry from normal sign-in
Added automatic workspace resolution for single-workspace accounts
Added workspace picker for multi-workspace accounts
Added friendly frontend error normalization for authentication and service failures
Removed developer-facing infrastructure diagnostics from the customer-facing frontend
Updated browser metadata and favicon assets to the LEXA brand
Added workspace registration hardening migration 008
Added workspace selection migration 009
Applied and verified migrations 008 and 009 on the LEXA development branch
Verified the LEXA production branch remained untouched
